item.title: Low-pressure pneumoperitoneum fails to reduce pain after laparoscopic cholecystectomy
item.description: Low-pressure pneumoperitoneum at 8 mmHg did not significantly lower visual analog scale pain scores at 6 hours compared with standard pressure.

item.title: Deep learning model shows potential to generate interpretable brain health biomarker from sleep EEG
item.description: Ganglberger and colleagues evaluated a deep learning model's ability to derive brain health scores from electroencephalography data.

item.title: When Is Limb Salvage Too Risky? Lessons From Gaza's Surgeons
item.description: In Gaza, surgeons weigh limb salvage against amputation amid limited resources, infection risks, and uncertain access to follow-up surgery.

item.title: Budesonide Tablets Reduce Esophageal Strictures After ESD
item.description: High-dose budesonide reduced esophageal stricture formation and the need for dilation after extensive ESD, though questions remain on how it compares.
